process_name: Anti-TNF IgG1 Monoclonal Antibody - CHO Fed-Batch Process

unit_operations.name: Cell Thaw & Seed Train Expansion
unit_operations.description: Thaw WCB vial, expand through shake flasks and seed bioreactors (N-2, N-1) over 10-12 days to reach inoculation density.

unit_operations.name: Production Bioreactor (Fed-Batch)
unit_operations.description: 200 L fed-batch culture with daily glucose-controlled feed, 14-day run, temperature shift on day 7 to extend productivity.

unit_operations.name: Harvest Clarification
unit_operations.description: Depth filtration followed by 0.2 um sterile filtration to remove cells and debris.
unit_operations.equipment: Depth filter train + 0.2 um PES filter

unit_operations.name: Protein A Capture Chromatography
unit_operations.description: MabSelect SuRe resin, bind-elute mode, low pH elution.
unit_operations.equipment: Protein A column, 20 cm bed height

unit_operations.name: Low pH Viral Inactivation
unit_operations.description: Hold Protein A eluate at low pH for 60 min to inactivate enveloped viruses, then neutralize.

unit_operations.name: Anion Exchange Polish (Flow-Through)
unit_operations.description: AEX membrane/resin flow-through mode to remove HCP, DNA, and aggregates.

unit_operations.name: Cation Exchange Polish (Bind-Elute)
unit_operations.description: CEX bind-elute step to further remove HCP, leached Protein A, and charge variants.

unit_operations.name: Viral Filtration
unit_operations.description: Nanofiltration (20 nm pore) for robust parvovirus clearance.

unit_operations.name: UF/DF Formulation
unit_operations.description: Ultrafiltration/diafiltration to target concentration and final formulation buffer.

unit_operations.name: Sterile Filtration & Fill
unit_operations.description: 0.2 um sterile filtration into final bulk containers.
